audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[].side read "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Ekko/Ekko. Separately, the packet itself flags that this chart contradicts the win rate: Ekko takes 54.3% over 941 games while the chart hands Qiyana five of seven stages.
audit.why: I can ground the layer alignment from the kits (Qiyana's Q is 525 range, W is a 1100 dash that enchants, Audacity is 11s at rank 1 and 7s at max, and the whole kit front-loads), but I cannot decide from the kits alone whether the chart or the win rate is the wrong artifact. The chart rule says a stale row beats a row that argues with itself, so I aligned the layers and left the verdicts where the data source has them.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved onto the content values, with every affected why rewritten in the same proposal. The chart-versus-win-rate contradiction is escalated rather than guessed at.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a cooldown, and the level-6 spike described her ultimate as extending dash and stun range without saying what it costs her.
audit.why: enemyKit R is a flat 120s at every rank, 950 range, and it detonates terrain for the knockup — it does not scale down at all, while Chronobreak drops 110s to 50s across its three ranks.
audit.corrected: The level 6 spike now states the flat 120s against your 110s falling to 50s, which is the real spike shape of this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Supreme Display of Talent detonates elements it passes through, so the stun exists only where there is terrain — and Terrashape both creates terrain and is what arms her Q's bonus effect. Nothing on the page told you that standing away from walls removes the stun entirely.
audit.why: enemyKit R flags: projectile, knockup, hardCC, terrain; text: detonates whatever elements she hits with it. enemyKit W flags: dash, terrain; text: enchants her weapon, and her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while enchanted.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, dos, trading and the whys now say the stun needs terrain and that her Q bonus is whatever Terrashape last picked up, so the ground you stand on is the fight.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Audacity 11s at rank 1 to 7s, Elemental Wrath and Terrashape both flat 7s, and Supreme Display of Talent flat 120s.
